order: Draw up the delta re-review order and its executor report for the round-3 fixes. Pin the review to the commit range spanning the round-2 and round-3 checkpoints, and keep that pin as the sole boundary of the audit. Scope the audit strictly to what changed in that fix set, leaving earlier rounds' findings alone since those already carry their own closed verdicts and need no relitigating here. Add the order and the executor report as new files under roster/, matching the shape used for the other delta rounds: touch no existing roster record, and leave every prior round's file byte-unchanged. State explicitly, as its own line, that a clean verdict on this exact pin is what clears the pending work orders out of revise status, so the audit's pass or fail outcome has exactly one concrete downstream consequence spelled out up front, and nothing else stands in for it.
claims: We produced the order and executor report as two new files under roster/: the executor report adds 55 lines and the order adds 62, for 117 lines total with zero deletions, so no existing roster file was touched. The pin covers the commit range between the round-2 and round-3 checkpoints. The order records that only a clean verdict on this exact pin clears the pending work orders out of revise status.
